title: NeRF
paper_title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
core_mech: 位置编码坐标 MLP 预测连续密度与视角相关颜色，再沿相机射线做可微体渲染。
core_mech_en: Represents a continuous 3D scene as a 5D coordinate MLP (x,y,z,θ,φ) → (σ, c) with Fourier positional encoding, optimized via differentiable emission–absorption volume rendering.
input_desc: 带相机内外参的多视角 RGB 图像与采样射线
input_en: 3D spatial coordinates x=(x,y,z) and 2D viewing direction d=(θ,φ) along calibrated camera rays
output_desc: 新视角渲染图像及连续密度/颜色场
output_en: Volume density σ(x), view-dependent RGB radiance c(x,d), and rendered 2D novel views

adapter.name: NeRF
adapter.mechanism: Coordinate/direction-conditioned density and radiance integrate using exclusive transmittance and emission-absorption compositing.
limitations: One synthetic scene; compact MLP and uniform finite-interval rays; no hierarchical coarse/fine sampling or original benchmark training.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.

verification.title: NeRF
